Market today: The market is facing a significant headwind as the 30-year Treasury yield hit a 19-year high due to inflation and spending concerns. This is a tough environment for your tech and chip-heavy portfolio, as higher rates typically hurt growth stock valuations.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down -50.84% and flagged SELL. SPAL, another leveraged ETF, is also deeply in the red at -35.83% and below its stop. Remember, margin amplifies these drops. SMH is also on TRIM at -11.01%.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Treasury yields; continued increases will pressure your tech names. Also, monitor your leveraged ETFs for further decay.

Bottom line: Focus on risk management and protecting capital in this challenging rate environment.
plays: Consider exiting SOXL given its deep -50.84% loss and leveraged decay, especially with the scanner's SELL status.
Review SPAL; it's a leveraged ETF down -35.83% and trading below its stated stop of 21.38. Consider trimming or exiting.
Trim SMH as indicated by the scanner, managing your exposure to the broader chip sector.
